In addition, it is important to consider notary fees and trespass tax. Notary fees can range from CHF 2,000 to CHF5,000, depending on the complexity of the contract. The transfer tax, on the other hand, can vary from CHF 2% to CHF 4% of the value of the house.
You can request additional information from a real estate agency or banking institution. For example, the real estate agency "Swiss Properties" offers advice and assistance for the purchase of houses in the Canton of Obvaldo, while the banking institution "UBS" offers mortgage mortgage and financial advisory services.
Operational checklist:
* Determine the purchase price of the home * Calculate the necessary mortgage loan * Consider notary fees and transfer tax * Request information
